purpose: The Card Token Vault processes primary account numbers (PANs) and ensures compliance with Meridian Pay Information Security Policy.

components.name: tokenization-service
components.evidence: tokenization-service, which exposes two operations to payment services: tokenization of a PAN and detokenization of a token;

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: vault-db (PostgreSQL), which stores card records in encrypted form;

components.name: Vault and KMS
components.evidence: Vault and KMS, which provide runtime secrets and data encryption keys;

flows.evidence: Payment services send PANs to the tokenization-service and receive tokens.
The tokenization-service writes the encrypted card data to vault-db
The tokenization-service writes request logs for every tokenize and detokenize call.
The tokenization-service also writes an audit record for every tokenize and detokenize operation to the log group.
